Marta (CS): Heads up — onboarding ingestion stalled for ~23 trial accounts this morning after a routing policy change accidentally pushed their provisioning traffic into a deprioritized pool. I pulled the affected list into the doc and flagged the six high-touch accounts. Need comms + enablement offers. @Priya (SE) can you confirm root cause and ETA? @Leo (Ops) can you confirm mitigation status?

Priya (SE): Investigating — we rolled a policy change at ~04:12 that introduced a tag normalization mismatch. Root cause: the routing layer normalized customer tags differently in the new policy, so some trial tenants matched the low-priority rule. We reverted the policy at ~04:35 and kicked a backfill/backfill queue. Backfill is running; expected catch-up for most tenants within ~2 hours. High-volume onboarders may need manual acceleration. Will post per-tenant ETAs in the doc.

Leo (Ops): Rollback completed at ~04:35 UTC, backfill jobs started and are progressing. No data loss detected. I've prioritized manual acceleration for the six high-touch tenants. Deploy Bot — can you post job IDs/status?

Deploy Bot: automated-note: rollback deployment ID dpl-2026-04-12-403 marked successful. Backfill jobs scheduled: job-7771, job-7772, job-7773, job-7774, job-7775, job-7776. Current average token processing rate back to normal.

Marta (CS): Thanks. I'm drafting outbound updates. Proposed plan: (1) Short apology + status to all affected tenants with expected window, (2) Offer two live enablement sessions (one labeled APAC/EU-friendly, one US-friendly) for hands-on onboarding help, (3) Complimentary service credit for impacted tenants with renewal exposure, and (4) Short feedback form link in the note. I will prepare a personalized variant for the six high-touch accounts.

Jamie (CS): I can own the personalized templates and schedule the 1:1 invites for the high-touch customers. Can someone drop the tenant list and priority buckets here?

Priya (SE): Shared the spreadsheet: <internal doc link> — includes tenant ID, upload size, status (backfill/needs manual re-ingest), and an ETA estimate. Two tenants require manual CSV re-ingest due to partial ingestion failures; we've validated partial artifacts.

Marta (CS): Draft outbound snippet for comments: "We're sorry — your onboarding ingestion was delayed because of a routing configuration error on our side. We've reverted the change, backfill is underway, and we expect full completion by 16:30 UTC for most accounts. We're offering a live onboarding session and a complimentary credit. Reply to this message if you'd like expedited manual assistance." Thoughts?

Sam (Support): :thumbsup: Add a clear 'what we need from you' line for customers who still see missing items: "Please confirm primary account owner email and whether you'd like manual re-ingest." Also include an opt-in checkbox for the enablement session.

Marta (CS): Agreed. Also want to capture feedback — can someone spin up a 3-4 question form (impact severity, did comms help, interest in enablement, accept credit)? We'll append link to the outbound.

Leo (Ops): I'll create the survey and post the link here in the next 20 minutes.

Jamie (CS): Proposed office hours: Tue 12:00 UTC and Wed 18:00 UTC. I'll create calendar invites and a short slide deck covering common troubleshooting and next steps.

Priya (SE): After backfill completes we'll run a validation pass and add per-tenant status notes to the doc (validation results, files restored, any required manual steps). Ops to confirm when done so CS can send the final 'resolved' message.

Marta (CS): Action items (owners):
1) Priya (SE) — finalize technical snippet for outbound comms and publish per-tenant ETAs (owner).
2) Leo (Ops) — confirm backfill completion, post logs for high-touch tenants, and share final timestamps (owner).
3) Jamie (CS) — draft personalized emails for six high-touch accounts and schedule office hours invites (owner).
4) Sam (Support) — prepare canned replies and a support playbook for incoming requests (owner).
5) Marta (CS) — coordinate customer credits and sign-off on outbound messaging.

Please ping here when your item is complete. :pray:

Deploy Bot: incident-note: postmortem ticket INC-2026-0412 created and linked: <internal ticket link>."
